title: Return Policy
content: Return & Refund Policy At Zyra Luxe , we want you to love your purchase. If for any reason you are not completely satisfied, we're here to help. Eligibility for Returns You may request a return within 2 hours from the time of delivery. To be eligible, the item must be unused, unworn, and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging with tags, bills, and accessories included. Customized, personalized items, sale items, and gift cards are non-returnable. Return Process To initiate a return, please contact our support team at info@zyraluxe.com with your order details. Once your request is approved, we will provide you with the return shipping address and instructions. Customers are responsible for return shipping costs unless the item is damaged, defective, or incorrect. Refunds After receiving and inspecting your return, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. If approved, your refund will be processed within 7-10 business days to your original payment method. Shipping fees, if any, are non-refundable. Exchanges Exchanges are allowed only for damaged or defective items. If you need a different size/product, please place a new order once your return is approved. Damaged or Incorrect Items If you receive a damaged, defective, or wrong product, please notify us within 2 hours of delivery with photos/videos as proof. We will arrange a replacement or full refund. Contact Us For any questions about returns and refunds, reach out to us: Email: zyraluxeofficial@gmail.com At Zyraluxe, we believe jewellery is more than an accessory - it's an expression of elegance, confidence, and timeless beauty.

title: Privacy Policy
content: Privacy Policy At Zyra Luxe , we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit our website or make a purchase. 1. Information We Collect Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, shipping/billing address, and payment details when you place an order. Non-Personal Information: Browser type, IP address, and browsing behavior through cookies and analytics tools. 2. How We Use Your Information To process and deliver your orders. To communicate with you regarding your order, inquiries, or promotions. To improve our website, services, and customer experience. To comply with legal obligations. 3. Sharing of Information We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information. We may share limited information only with: Trusted third-party service providers (e.g., payment processors, shipping partners). Authorities, when required by law or to protect our rights. 4. Data Security We take appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. However, please note that no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. 5. Cookies Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features of the site may not function properly. 6. Your Rights Access, update, or request deletion of your personal data. Opt-out of promotional emails by clicking the “unsubscribe” link. 7. Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated “last revised” date. 8. Contact Us If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us: Email: zyraluxeofficial@gmail.com At Zyraluxe, we believe jewellery is more than an accessory - it's an expression of elegance, confidence, and timeless beauty.
